name: Zeynep
presentingProblem: My husband passed away eight months ago. I thought I'd be doing better by now but I still can't function. I feel guilty for still being sad.
backstory: Zeynep is a high school teacher. She was married for 20 years. Her husband died suddenly of a heart attack. She has two teenage children she's trying to hold it together for. Her family and friends keep telling her 'you need to move on' which makes her feel worse. She was close to her husband and they made all decisions together. She feels lost making decisions alone.

coreBeliefs: I should be stronger than this
Grief this intense means something is wrong with me
I'm letting my children down by not coping better
intermediateBeliefs: If I let myself feel the full grief, I won't recover
Other people's grief ends sooner — I must be weak
automaticThoughts: I should be over this by now
My children need me to be strong
He would be disappointed in how I'm coping
I don't know who I am without him
triggers: Anything that reminds her of her husband's routine
values: Being a good teacher and community member
